name: HSBC Holdings
title: Follow up Interim Results 2026 Equity Analysts Meeting - Transcript

read.thesis: Post-results HSBC call reaffirms costs on plan and fee-led growth, but structural hedge stated at $637bn versus prior $604bn, and no new ECL or cost quantification; supply-side metrics absent for a bank.

triggers.label: Structural hedge $604bn → $637bn
triggers.quote: The structural hedge was around $637 billion, and the weighted average life has increased to 3.2 years.

triggers.label: Cost lines held; no 2027 cost outlook
triggers.quote: For this year, our costs are in line with what we called out.

triggers.label: Trade GTS lending up 30% to $120bn
triggers.quote: our GTS lending to customers and banks was also up 30% year-on-year to $120 billion.

guidance.quote: which we’ve increased from the original $1.5 billion to $2 billion
